newsitem.title: THAILAND: Iraq said buys 390,000 tonnes of Thai rice.
newsitem.headline: Iraq said buys 390,000 tonnes of Thai rice.

text.p: Iraq has bought 390,000 tonnes from Thailand this year, 300,000 tonnes of which are outside the United Nations' oil-for-food programme, a senior commerce ministry official told Reuters on Sunday.
Pracha Charutrakulchai, director general of the commerce ministry's foreign trade department, said all the purchases were 10-15 percent grade rice.
He did not reveal the value of the deals.
"Iraq bought 90,000 tonnes under the U.N.'s programme and the rest through our private sector," he said.
So far, 60,000 tonnes have been delivered and the rest will be shipped after June.
